# NUICSS (@nofinite/nuicss) - Full AI Context & Superclasses Reference

Semantic CSS utility framework, runtime-less design token engine, production-ready component superclasses, and modern OKLCH color system built directly on top of UnoCSS.

---

## Core Architecture & Engine
- **Engine**: UnoCSS instant atomic CSS compiler (<1ms generation).
- **Directives**:
  - `@nuicss;` in CSS expands to preflights, OKLCH design tokens, shortcuts, and utility rules.
  - `@apply` in stylesheets for inlining atomic classes into custom components.
- **Packaging & Delivery Modes**:
  - **Build-Time Compiler**: PostCSS plugin (`@nofinite/nuicss/postcss`) or Vite plugin (`nuicssVitePlugin`).
  - **Zero-Config Next.js & Turbopack**: `withNuicss(nextConfig)` via `@nofinite/nuicss/next` with automatic Turbopack alias resolution (`experimental.turbo.resolveAlias`).
  - **SSR Critical CSS Engine**: `extractCriticalNuicss(html)`, `extractCriticalCssForTokens(tokens)`, and in-memory LRU cache (`tokenCssCache`) via `@nofinite/nuicss/ssr` (<0.05ms latency, eliminates FOUC).
  - **Modular Static CSS Bundles (LightningCSS)**:
    - `dist/styles.min.css`: Complete bundle (all components + base + utilities).
    - `dist/components.min.css`: All superclasses.
    - `dist/primitives.min.css`: Buttons, Cards, Badges, Tables, Avatars.
    - `dist/forms.min.css`: Inputs, Textareas, Switches, Checkboxes, Selects.
    - `dist/overlays.min.css`: Modals, Drawers, Popovers, Tooltips, Context Menus.
    - `dist/widgets.min.css`: Metric Cards, Sparklines, Progress Rings, Tabs, Accordions.
    - `dist/media.min.css`: Carousels, Dropzones, Video Players.
  - **Drop-In Tailwind CDN Replacement**: `dist/index.global.js` (UnoCSS runtime + preset-wind4 + NUICSS engine) with full `window.tailwind` config ingestion and reactive configuration.
- **Layers**: Resets live in `@layer base`, component superclasses live in `@layer components`, and atomic utilities live in `@layer utilities`. DOM shielded with `data-nuicss-layer`.

---

## Theming & Design Tokens

### OKLCH Wide-Gamut (P3) Color System with Dual Fallbacks
All primitive neutrals and brand scales feature dual declarations: legacy sRGB hex fallbacks followed immediately by exact OKLCH values. Supports Display-P3 wide color gamut enhancements for maximum saturation on modern displays:
- `@supports (color: color(display-p3 1 1 1)) { ... }`

### Semantic Backgrounds
- `bg-page`: Main background canvas (`--bg-page`)
- `bg-canvas`: Viewport / app canvas background (`--bg-canvas`)
- `bg-surface`: Card and container background (`--bg-surface`)
- `bg-surface-raised`: Elevated card background (`--bg-surface-raised`)
- `bg-surface-overlay`: Modal and overlay container background (`--bg-surface-overlay`)
- `bg-subtle`: Subtle secondary surface (`--bg-subtle`)
- `bg-muted`: Muted background fill (`--bg-muted`)
- `bg-accent`: Accent highlight background (`--bg-accent`)
- `bg-card`: Explicit card surface background (`--bg-card`)
- `bg-glass`: Translucent backdrop surface (`--glass-bg`)
- `bg-overlay`: Modal backdrop dimming (`--bg-overlay`)

### Semantic Foreground / Text
- `text-default`: Primary body text (`--fg-default`)
- `text-subtle`: Secondary descriptive text (`--fg-subtle`)
- `text-muted`: Muted labels and placeholder text (`--fg-muted`)
- `text-accent`: Accent text color (`--fg-accent`)
- `text-inverse`: Contrast text on dark/inverted surfaces (`--fg-inverse`)
- `text-disabled`: Disabled text (`--fg-disabled`)
- `text-card`: Card foreground text (`--fg-card`)

### Action & Feedback Colors
- `primary`: Brand primary action color (`--color-primary`, `--color-primary-hover`, `--color-primary-active`, `--color-primary-fg`, `--color-primary-subtle`)
- `secondary`: Secondary action color (`--color-secondary`, `--color-secondary-hover`, `--color-secondary-active`, `--color-secondary-fg`, `--color-secondary-subtle`)
- `danger`: Error and destructive actions (`--color-danger`, `--color-danger-hover`, `--color-danger-fg`, `--color-danger-subtle`)
- `success`: Positive confirmation and status (`--color-success`, `--color-success-hover`, `--color-success-fg`, `--color-success-subtle`)
- `warning`: Cautionary alerts (`--color-warning`, `--color-warning-hover`, `--color-warning-fg`, `--color-warning-subtle`)
- `info`: Informational messages (`--color-info`, `--color-info-hover`, `--color-info-fg`, `--color-info-subtle`)

### Semantic Borders
- `border-default`: Standard container border (`--border-default`)
- `border-subtle`: Low contrast divider border (`--border-subtle`)
- `border-strong`: High contrast card / element border (`--border-strong`)
- `border-hover`: Border hover state (`--border-hover`)
- `border-focus`: Form element focus border (`--border-focus`)
- `border-disabled`: Disabled element border (`--border-disabled`)
- `border-glass`: Glassmorphism translucent border (`--glass-border`)
- Supports directional prefixes: `border-t-default`, `border-b-subtle`, `border-x-strong`, `border-y-default`

### Native Opacity Modifier Support
All semantic background, text, and border utilities support opacity modifiers:
- `bg-surface/80`, `bg-subtle/50`, `bg-primary/20`
- `text-default/90`, `text-subtle/70`
- `border-default/50`, `border-x-strong/60`

### Fluid Typography Scale (`clamp()`)
Smooth viewport-responsive typography scaling automatically from 375px to 1440px:
- `text-fluid-xs`, `text-fluid-sm`, `text-fluid-base`, `text-fluid-lg`, `text-fluid-xl`, `text-fluid-2xl`, `text-fluid-3xl`, `text-fluid-4xl`, `text-fluid-5xl`, `text-fluid-hero`

### Fluid Spacing Scale (`clamp()`)
- `p-fluid-xs`, `p-fluid-sm`, `p-fluid-md`, `p-fluid-lg`, `p-fluid-xl`
- `px-fluid-*`, `py-fluid-*`, `gap-fluid-*`

### Container Queries (`@container`)
- `cq`: Marks element as a container (`container-type: inline-size`)
- `cq-normal`: Resets container type to normal
- Responsive shortcuts:
  - `card-responsive`: `@container flex flex-col @sm:flex-row @sm:items-center`
  - `stat-card-responsive`: `@container flex flex-col justify-between p-5 rounded-xl border border-default bg-surface shadow-sm @sm:flex-row @sm:items-center`

### Physics-Based Cubic-Bezier Easings & Micro-Interactions
- Tokens:
  - `--ease-spring`: `cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)`
  - `--ease-bounce`: `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)`
  - `--ease-smooth`: `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`
  - `--ease-out-expo`: `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`
- Utilities: `ease-spring`, `ease-bounce`, `ease-smooth`, `ease-out-expo`
- Micro-interaction Superclasses:
  - `press-scale`: `active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform duration-150 ease-spring select-none`
  - `hover-lift`: `hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-smooth`
  - `focus-ring`: `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[var(--bg-canvas)]`
  - `glow-brand`: `shadow-[0_0_20px_var(--color-primary-subtle)]`
  - `skeleton-shimmer`: Shimmering gradient loading animation

### Accessibility (WCAG AAA, High-Contrast & Reduced Motion)
- **Declarative ARIA State Bindings**:
  - `btn`: Automatically binds `aria-busy="true"` (`opacity-70 cursor-wait`) and `aria-disabled="true"` (`opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none`).
  - `dropdown-item`, `context-menu-item`: Automatically bind `aria-disabled="true"`.
  - `modal`, `dialog`, `drawer`, `popover`, `tooltip`: Automatically bind `aria-hidden="true"` (`display: none`).
  - `checkbox`, `radio`: Automatically bind `aria-checked="true"`.
- **WCAG AAA Guideline 2.3.3**: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` zeroes all transition and animation durations across all elements.
- **High-Contrast**: `@media (prefers-contrast: more)` automatically boosts border contrast and elevates focus ring widths.

---

## Complete Component Superclasses Dictionary

All superclasses support dual naming: concise syntax (e.g. `btn`, `card`) and namespace-isolated syntax (e.g. `nui-btn`, `nui-card`).

### 1. Primitives

#### Button (`btn`)
Interactive button with keyboard navigation rings and micro-scaling.
- Base: `btn` / `nui-btn`
- Variants:
  - `btn-default`: Standard border and surface fill
  - `btn-primary`: Brand primary filled button
  - `btn-secondary`: Neutral slate filled button
  - `btn-outline`: Transparent background with border-strong
  - `btn-ghost`: Borderless button with hover state
  - `btn-danger`: Error / destructive action
  - `btn-link`: Inline text hyperlink style
- Sizes: `btn-sm`, `btn-md`, `btn-lg`, `btn-icon`
- States & ARIA: `aria-busy="true"`, `aria-disabled="true"`, `btn-loading`, `press-scale`, `hover-lift`

#### Badge (`badge`)
Compact status indicator.
- Base: `badge` / `nui-badge`
- Variants: `badge-default`, `badge-primary`, `badge-success`, `badge-warning`, `badge-danger`, `badge-info`, `badge-subtle`
- Sizes: `badge-sm`, `badge-md`, `badge-lg`
- Modifiers: `badge-pill` (fully rounded), `badge-dot` (bullet dot indicator)

#### Card (`card`)
Content card container with shadow elevation.
- Base: `card` / `nui-card`
- Variants: `card-bordered`
- Slots: `card-header`, `card-title`, `card-description`, `card-body`, `card-footer`
- Responsive / Interactive: `card-responsive`, `hover-lift`

#### Table Container (`table-container`)
Responsive container for data tables with border containment and overflow scrolling.
- Base: `table-container`
- Usage: `<div class="table-container"><table>...</table></div>`

#### Avatar (`avatar`)
User profile image or initials wrapper.
- Base: `avatar` / `nui-avatar`
- Sizes: `avatar-sm`, `avatar-md`, `avatar-lg`, `avatar-xl`
- Shapes: `avatar-circle`, `avatar-square`
- Media: `avatar-image`
- Status indicators: `avatar-online`, `avatar-busy`, `avatar-away`
- Group: `avatar-group` (overlapping avatar stack)

#### Divider (`divider`)
Separators for layouts and lists.
- `divider`: Horizontal border divider
- `divider-text`: Horizontal divider with centered label text
- `divider-vertical`: Vertical inline separator bar

#### Kbd (`kbd`)
Keyboard shortcut badge.
- Base: `kbd` / `nui-kbd`
- Sizes: `kbd-sm`, `kbd-md`, `kbd-lg`

#### Skeleton (`skeleton`)
Loading placeholder animation.
- Base: `skeleton` / `nui-skeleton`
- Shapes: `skeleton-text`, `skeleton-circle`, `skeleton-rect`
- Micro-interaction: `skeleton-shimmer` (gradient animated shimmer)

#### Spinner (`spinner`)
Circular indeterminate loading animation.
- Base: `spinner` / `nui-spinner`
- Sizes: `spinner-sm`, `spinner-md`, `spinner-lg`
- Color: `spinner-primary`

#### Empty State (`empty-state`)
Zero-data placeholder layout.
- Slots: `empty-state-icon`, `empty-state-title`, `empty-state-description`, `empty-state-actions`

#### Stat Card & Metrics (`stat-card`, `metric-card`)
- Base: `stat-card`, `stat-card-responsive`, `metric-card`
- Slots: `stat-card-label`, `stat-card-value`, `stat-card-trend`, `stat-card-trend-up`, `stat-card-trend-down`
- Metrics: `metric-label`, `metric-value`, `metric-trend-up`, `metric-trend-down`

#### Pure CSS Charts & Data Visualizations
Zero-JS CSS charts that render instantly in HTML:
- Horizontal Bar: `chart-bar-horizontal`
  - Fills: `chart-bar-fill`, `chart-bar-fill-success`, `chart-bar-fill-danger`, `chart-bar-fill-warning`
- Vertical Group: `chart-bar-vertical-group`, `chart-bar-vertical`
- Sparklines: `sparkline-container`, `sparkline-bar`, `sparkline`
- Progress Rings: `progress-ring-container`
- Chart Canvas: `chart-container`, `chart-grid`, `chart-axes`

---

### 2. Forms & Feedback

#### Input (`input`)
- Base: `input`
- Sizes: `input-sm`, `input-md`, `input-lg`
- ARIA State: Native `aria-invalid="true"` styles error border and focus ring automatically!
- Variants: `input-error`
- Group: `input-group`, `input-addon-left`, `input-addon-right`, `input-has-addon-left`, `input-has-addon-right`

#### Textarea (`textarea`)
- Base: `textarea`
- ARIA State: Native `aria-invalid="true"`
- Variants: `textarea-error`

#### Checkbox & Radio
- Checkbox: `checkbox`, `checkbox-sm`, `checkbox-md`, `checkbox-lg`, `checkbox-label`
- Radio: `radio`, `radio-sm`, `radio-md`, `radio-lg`, `radio-label`, `radio-group`

#### Switch (`switch`)
- Base: `switch` (responds to `aria-checked="true"` or `data-[state=checked]`)
- Slots: `switch-thumb`, `switch-label`

#### Select (`select`)
- Base: `select`
- Sizes: `select-sm`, `select-lg`
- ARIA State: Native `aria-invalid="true"`

---

### 3. Overlays & Dialogs

#### Modal & Dialog (`modal`, `dialog`)
- Base: `modal`
- Slots: `modal-backdrop`, `modal-content`, `modal-header`, `modal-title`, `modal-description`, `modal-body`, `modal-footer`, `modal-close`

#### Drawer (`drawer`)
- Positions: `drawer-left`, `drawer-right`, `drawer-top`, `drawer-bottom`
- Slots: `drawer-backdrop`, `drawer-content`, `drawer-header`, `drawer-body`, `drawer-footer`

#### Popover & Dropdown
- Popover: `popover`, `popover-content`, `popover-arrow`
- Dropdown: `dropdown`, `dropdown-menu`, `dropdown-item`, `dropdown-separator`, `dropdown-header`
- Context Menu: `context-menu`, `context-menu-content`, `context-menu-item`

#### Tooltip & HoverCard
- Tooltip: `tooltip`, `tooltip-content`, `tooltip-top`, `tooltip-bottom`, `tooltip-left`, `tooltip-right`
- HoverCard: `hover-card`, `hover-card-content`

---

### 4. Interactive Widgets

#### Tabs (`tabs`)
- Base: `tabs`
- Slots: `tab-list`, `tab-list-pills`, `tab`, `tab-pill`, `tab-panel`
- ARIA State: Responds automatically to `aria-selected="true"` or `data-[state=active]`!

#### Accordion & Collapsible
- Accordion: `accordion`, `accordion-item`, `accordion-header`, `accordion-icon`, `accordion-content`, `accordion-body`
  - ARIA State: `accordion-icon` rotates automatically when `aria-expanded="true"`!
- Collapsible: `collapsible`, `collapsible-trigger`, `collapsible-content`, `collapsible-body`

#### Stepper (`stepper`)
- Base: `stepper`
- Elements: `step`, `step-indicator`, `step-content`, `step-title`, `step-description`, `step-connector`

#### DataGrid & Kanban
- DataGrid: `datagrid`, `datagrid-row`, `datagrid-pagination`
- Kanban: `kanban-board`, `kanban-column`, `kanban-card`

#### Metric Cards, Sparklines & Data Visualizations
Pure CSS zero-JS data visualization superclasses:
- Metric Cards: `metric-card`, `metric-label`, `metric-value`, `metric-trend-up`, `metric-trend-down`
- Trend Badges: `metric-badge`, `metric-badge-success`, `metric-badge-danger`
- Sparklines: `sparkline-container`, `sparkline-bar`, `sparkline-bar-success`, `sparkline-bar-danger`
- Circular Progress: `progress-ring-container`, `progress-ring`
- Horizontal Bars: `chart-bar-horizontal`, `chart-bar-fill`, `chart-bar-fill-success`, `chart-bar-fill-danger`, `chart-bar-fill-warning`

---

## Migration Tools

### Automated CLI Codemod
Refactor legacy Tailwind / utility clusters to clean NUICSS superclasses:
```bash
npx @nofinite/nuicss migrate
npx @nofinite/nuicss migrate --dry-run
```

### Programmatic API
```ts
import { migrateMarkupToNuicss } from '@nofinite/nuicss/migrate';
const { result, replacementsCount } = migrateMarkupToNuicss(htmlCode);
```
